//: Auto-loaded by Claude Code. Registers the memini MCP server (memory_remember/recall/get/forget). Works local AND remote: set MEMINI_BASE_URL to your memini host (the /mcp suffix is appended here) and MEMINI_API_KEY to its token (MEMINI_TOKEN is an accepted alias for back-compat). NOTE: Claude Code expands ${VAR:-default} in this file FLAT — it does NOT support nested ${a:-${b:-c}} defaults (the inner braces leak into the value, e.g. https://host/mcp}/mcp}). So the URL keeps the variable in a single ${MEMINI_BASE_URL:-...} and appends the literal /mcp OUTSIDE the braces; don't add a trailing slash to MEMINI_BASE_URL. headersHelper resolves the per-project namespace + bearer via mcp-headers.mjs. headersHelper runs in a bare shell and does NOT receive ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} (unlike hooks/command), so we can't put it in the path directly. The SessionStart hook writes the plugin root to $XDG_CACHE_HOME/memini/plugin-root and this helper reads it to locate the script. On a cold first connect (before SessionStart) it falls back to emitting just the bearer token so auth still succeeds and Claude Code doesn't drop into OAuth discovery.

memini.headersHelper: R=$(cat "${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-$HOME/.cache}/memini/plugin-root" 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$R" ] && [ -f "$R/scripts/mcp-headers.mjs" ]; then exec node "$R/scripts/mcp-headers.mjs"; fi; t="${MEMINI_API_KEY:-$MEMINI_TOKEN}"; if [ -n "$t" ]; then printf '{"Authorization":"Bearer %s"}' "$t"; else printf '{}'; fi
